post.description: Step 1 of the two-step upload flow. Use the returned `uploadUrl` to PUT the file directly to R2, then call `POST /media/confirm` with the returned `key`. Allowed MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp` (max **25 MB** each — exposed as `maxBytes` in the response so the CMS should validate before starting the PUT). The signed URL is bound to the requesting user — only that user can confirm the upload. The response also includes the `mediaId` that will be created at confirm time, so the CMS can stage references while the upload is in flight. R2 layout: originals at `media/originals/<mediaId>/<slug>.<ext>`; variants at `media/variants/<mediaId>/w<width>.webp`. Requires permission: `media:create`.

200.description: Returns a pre-signed PUT URL (valid for 15 minutes), the storage key, the planned mediaId, and the per-MIME byte cap

400.description: Validation failed, or MIME type not in the allowlist

post.summary: Request a pre-signed R2 upload URL

post.description:
Step 2 of the two-step upload flow. Call after successfully PUTting the file to R2 using the signed URL. The server verifies the key is one this user requested via `/media/upload-url`, and authoritatively reads the actual stored Content-Type and Content-Length from R2 (client-supplied values are not trusted). If the stored size exceeds the per-MIME cap (currently 25 MB for images) the R2 object is deleted and a 413 is returned. On success the media row is created with the same `mediaId` baked into the upload key, and both originals and variants share the `<mediaId>` folder segment in R2.

**Variants are generated in the background.** The response returns immediately with `variants: []`; EXIF-oriented WebP variants (320/768/1280/1920 px) finish populating ~1–3 seconds later. Poll `GET /media/:id` until `variants.length === 4`, or fall back to the original `url` until they land. If they stay empty past ~10 s, call `POST /media/:id/regenerate-variants`. Requires permission: `media:create`.

201.description: Media record registered in the database. Returns the media object with `variants: []` — variants populate asynchronously and become visible on subsequent `GET /media/:id` calls.

400.description: Validation failed, the key is not under the managed prefix, or the file was not uploaded to R2

403.description: The key was issued to a different user

404.description: No pending upload exists for that key — request a new upload URL first

413.description: Uploaded file exceeds the per-MIME byte cap (`maxBytes` from the upload-url response); R2 object is purged

get.description:
Searches published posts, books, academic papers and gallery image captions. Results are grouped by resource type and **ranked by relevance** (Postgres `pg_trgm` similarity score), so the best match for each type appears first. Public — only returns content that is visible to anonymous users (published posts; non-deleted everything else). Rate-limited to 60 calls/minute/IP. Response is CDN-cacheable (`public, max-age=30, s-maxage=60`) and varies by `Accept-Language` — popular queries get amortised at the CDN.

**Implementation note:** the query uses the trigram `%` similarity operator against the GIN indexes (`idx_*_*_trgm`), so substring matches stay sub-10 ms regardless of corpus size. Each hit returns the translation that actually matched the query, not the language-resolved one — an Arabic search hitting an English summary returns the English row.

REST API for imamzain.org — Islamic content management, digital library, gallery, forms, and contest.

**Authentication:** Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Obtain one via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

**Language:** Send `Accept-Language: ar` (or any supported ISO 639-1 code) to receive translated content. Falls back to the default translation when the requested language is unavailable.
